description:
Hushfeed v0.49.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Settings now keep invalid values beside the field, offer Undo for destructive actions after navigation and explain restart state without losing it. The home shortcuts become full-width rows at Android's first large-text step, so their names stay intact. Labels and controls now share one visual and writing system across all supported languages.

Validation: 1462 runtime tests passed locally, plus 243 patch tests. Both Android lint checks passed. The bundle carries 91 patches and all three nonempty DEX payloads. Every patch applied with zero failures to TikTok 47.0.3 and the retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures, with no unexpected manifest changes. S22 acceptance covered launch, first-row placement, version reporting, inline validation, restart feedback, Undo after navigation, AMOLED dark and the corrected 1.3 large-text layout. The signing key and app data were preserved, and the phone was restored to its original display and theme settings. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
